title: Start with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Foundry
summary: Understand the purchasing assistant and choose a path matching your readiness.

title: Create your portal environment (Project / RBAC)
summary: Create a dedicated group/logging in Azure portal and an account/project in Microsoft Foundry, checking owned scope.
status: Portal creation / access changes separately approved

title: Deploy a model in the portal (Model Deployment)
summary: Inspect exact model/version, SKU, TPM, and processing location before creating only approved deployments.

title: First answer in Model playground (Responses API concepts)
summary: Send one synthetic-rule question in portal Chat and inspect actual text, usage, and visible IDs.
status: Portal execution / no direct API exercise

title: Create an agent with a clear role (Prompt Agent)
summary: Give a Prompt Agent rules, then compare the same conversation with a new one.

title: Answer from company documents (File search / RAG)
summary: Use File search to retrieve policies and inspect actual supporting evidence.

title: Function Calling boundaries and Capstone inspection
summary: Verify no function backend exists; distinguish answers/citations from unknown inventory and unexecuted persistence/approval.

title: Read-only MCP and OpenAPI boundaries
summary: Conditionally test Microsoft Learn MCP in supported portal UI and inspect backend/authentication limits.

title: Compare v1/v2 using CSV (Evaluation)
summary: Map twelve fixed questions to two tool-free agents; compare portal originals, errors, and a manual checklist.
status: New portal experiment / separate from historical SDK evidence

title: Reject missing facts and false approval (Safety / Guardrails)
summary: Inspect three boundary questions and actual settings, separating verbal refusal, filters, and backend validation.
status: Settings inspection / no function or red-team execution

title: Follow an answer's execution path (Tracing)
summary: Find a run's operations and durations in Traces to narrow latency and failure causes.

title: Compare Azure AI Search and Foundry IQ in the portal
summary: Inspect Knowledge; import/index/search three policies only with separately approved additional resources.

title: Hosted Agent source, packaging, and deployment (Terminal / azd)
summary: Inspect source/local packages, then follow separately approved single-service deployment and one exact-version invocation.
status: Offline default / paid deployment separately approved

title: Run real MAF: sequential transfer and concurrent fan-out
summary: Execute actual SDK builders with offline fixtures; optionally compare transfer, branching, and originals on an approved existing model.

title: Real MAF collaboration: group chat and handoff
summary: Verify three-turn revision, actual handoff tools, and specialist responses. Remote A2A, HITL, and business approval remain references.
status: SDK handoff / A2A and HITL separate

title: Inspect Memory and conditionally compare recall
summary: Separate exposed stores/scopes/TTL and new-Chat recall from untested CRUD, isolation, and deletion.

title: Inspect Routines forms, timezones, and identity
summary: Read the creation form and cancel. Default: zero creations, dispatches, or external connectors.

title: Read-only access, connections, and governance inspection
summary: Inspect user/runtime/data scopes and review synthetic cache/ACL decisions.

title: Evaluation gates, Versions, and release decisions
summary: Compare actual runs/candidate versions and hold on failures or unknowns. No CI, publishing, activation, or rollback.

title: Finish the lab and check costs (Microsoft Cost Management)
summary: After core or selected advanced labs, record resource state, retention ownership, and the next cost-check time.

title: Troubleshooting by symptom
summary: Resolve 401, 403, 404, and 429 errors, empty search results, and unexpected costs.

title: Your progress and completion checklist
summary: Record your setup, capability prerequisites, time plan, actual outcomes, and costs.

title: Glossary and decision guide
summary: Clarify confusing names with short definitions and selection criteria.

title: Feature coverage
summary: See how official capability groups map to the labs.

title: Official sources and feature availability
summary: Check official documentation for feature-specific GA/Preview status, regions, and permissions.
